name: Coding
description: Build or change software in small, verifiable steps: plan, decide, build, review.

sections.instructions: Record each answer in Decisions (answer_question with recordIn: decisions).

sections.title: Context and links
sections.collects: Where things are: the issue, upstream references, entry points in the code, the branch and PR once they exist, local tools and environments.

sections.title: Constraints and non-goals
sections.collects: Limits the work must respect, and what is deliberately out of scope.

sections.title: Acceptance criteria
sections.collects: Conditions that prove the goal is met, written as what will be true.

sections.instructions: Each step ends in one commit: once its tasks are ticked, verify it (tests, lint, type checks), commit it on its own with the step in the message, and mark it done with the commit as its link.

sections.collects: Out-of-scope work noticed along the way, never done in the current change. The user decides what happens to each: a Plan step, a tracker or another workbook, or dropped.

sections.title: Decisions
sections.collects: Choices the user made or confirmed, each with why and what was rejected.
sections.instructions: Record a decision only once the user has made or confirmed it.

sections.title: Findings
sections.collects: Facts learned while working, each with how we know; for a gap or limitation, its status and the step that handles it.
